title: macOS
summary: A macOS test machine needs every privacy pair the bridge drives: Automation from /usr/libexec/sshd-keygen-wrapper to System Events, Terminal and Safari; Automation from Terminal to System Events; Accessibility for the helper and Terminal; Screen Recording for Terminal. Older macOS opens System Preferences instead of a consent dialog, so the Terminal to System Events row is ticked by hand. bridge-diagnose and every Terminal case start probe System Events from inside Terminal and refuse terminal_system_events_automation_missing on -1743, terminal_system_events_automation_timeout on a timeout, or terminal_window_accumulation:<n> on a timeout with more than 10 windows shown. Windows are force-closed by killing their tty processes; bridge-diagnose reports the window count and fails terminal_window_close_failed when its own window stays open.
